component.summary: Universal card game: Sevens, Nines, Parliament, and Fan Tan
Универсальная карточная игра: Семёрки, Девятка, Parliament и Фан Тан
Універсальна карткова гра: Сімки, Дев'ятка, Parliament та Фан Тан

description.p: A cross-platform universal layout card game engine featuring traditional Russian "Nines" (36 cards), international "Sevens / Parliament" (52 cards), and "Fan Tan / Card Dominoes" (with pot and chips penalty system).
Кроссплатформенная карточная игра с поддержкой классической русской «Девятки» (36 карт), международных «Семёрок / Parliament» (52 карты) и азартного «Fan Tan» (с фишками и банком).

ul.li: Smart tactical AI bots with strategic card-holding logic
8 beautiful built-in card back styles plus custom local photo upload
Procedural Web Audio sound effects (card deals, table snaps, chips, victory)
Multiple table cloth felt colors (Emerald, Sapphire, Velvet Burgundy, Slate)

description.p: Initial release with full Nines, Sevens, Parliament, Fan Tan rules, 8 card backs, custom image upload, and AI bots.
